questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre of 1919 took place on which festival day?
questions.explanation: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on 13 April 1919, which coincided with Baisakhi, the Punjabi harvest festival.

questions.question: Kaziranga National Park, famous for the one-horned rhinoceros, is located in which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Kaziranga National Park is located in Assam and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.question: The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on which date?
questions.explanation: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950.

questions.question: The Sun Temple at Konark, shaped like a giant chariot with twelve pairs of wheels, was built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Konark Sun Temple was built by King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Ganga dynasty in the 13th century.

questions.question: The Pong Dam (Beas Dam), one of the highest earthfill dams in India, is located in which state?
questions.explanation: The Pong Dam is located on the Beas river near Talwara in Himachal Pradesh.

questions.question: The Vijayanagara Empire, founded in 1336, was established by which two brothers?
questions.explanation: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 by brothers Harihara I and Bukka I.

questions.question: Article 370 of the Constitution, which granted special status to Jammu and Kashmir, was abrogated by the Government of India in which year?
questions.explanation: Article 370 was effectively abrogated on 5 August 2019.

questions.question: The 2025 Booker Prize was awarded to David Szalay for his novel 'Flesh'. Szalay is a citizen of which country?
questions.explanation: David Szalay is a Hungarian-British author and the first Hungarian-British writer to win the Booker Prize.

questions.question: The 38th National Games of India, held in 2025 after a gap of several years, were hosted by which state?
questions.explanation: The 38th National Games were held in Uttarakhand from 28 January to 14 February 2025.

questions.question: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun for the discovery of which biological molecule?
questions.explanation: Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun discovered microRNA and its role in post-transcriptional gene regulation.

questions.question: ISRO's Chandrayaan-4 mission, approved by the Union Cabinet in September 2024, is designed to achieve which objective?
options: A) First Indian crewed space flight
C) Soft landing on the lunar surface
D) Lunar sample return to Earth
questions.explanation: Chandrayaan-4 is India's lunar sample return mission, approved in September 2024.

questions.question: In the ICC Champions Trophy final held in Dubai in March 2025, India defeated which team to win the title?
questions.explanation: India defeated New Zealand by four wickets in the ICC Champions Trophy 2025 final.

questions.question: On 7 May 2025, India launched a military campaign codenamed Operation Sindoor in response to which incident?
questions.explanation: Operation Sindoor was launched in response to the Pahalgam terror attack of 22 April 2025.

questions.question: In the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won how many seats?
questions.explanation: The BJP won 240 seats in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.

questions.question: Pen is to Poet as Brush is to:
questions.explanation: A pen is the tool used by a poet, just as a brush is the tool used by a painter.

questions.question: In a certain code, SCHOOL is written as TDIPPM. How will TEACHER be written in that same code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted one step forward in the alphabet.

questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a woman said: 'He is the son of the daughter of my mother.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: 'Daughter of my mother' refers to the woman herself. So 'son of the daughter of my mother' means the woman's own son.

questions.question: Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way. Which one is different?
questions.explanation: 2116 = 46^2, 2209 = 47^2, 2304 = 48^2 are all perfect squares. 2402 is not a perfect square.

questions.question: Find the next term in the series: 2, 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
questions.explanation: The pattern is: each term equals (previous term x 2) + 1. So 47x2+1=95.

questions.question: If COMPUTER is written as DPNQVUFS in a certain code, how will SCIENCE be written in the same code?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by one position in the alphabet. SCIENCE becomes TDFOFDF.

questions.question: A person walks 10 m north, turns right and walks 6 m, then turns right again and walks 10 m. How far is the person from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Walking 10 m north, turning right (east) walking 6 m, then turning right (south) walking 10 m brings the person 6 m east of the starting point.

questions.question: What is 35% of 640?
The average of 6 numbers is 18. If one number is excluded, the average of the remaining 5 becomes 16. What is the excluded number?
questions.explanation: Sum of 6 numbers = 108. Sum of 5 numbers = 80. Excluded number = 28.

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys a toy for Rs. 350 and sells it for Rs. 420. What is his profit percentage?
What is the simple interest on Rs. 5,000 at 8% per annum for 2 years?
questions.explanation: Simple Interest = (5000 x 8 x 2)/100 = Rs. 800.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 5. If their sum is 120, what is the larger number?
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be 3x and 5x. Sum = 8x = 120, so x = 15. Larger number = 75.

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 20 days. B can do the same work in 30 days. In how many days will they finish the work together?
questions.explanation: A's one day work = 1/20, B's one day work = 1/30. Together = 1/20 + 1/30 = 1/12. So they finish in 12 days.

questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually.
A number is increased by 25% and then decreased by 25%. What is the net percentage change?
questions.explanation: Let the number be 100. After 25% increase: 125. After 25% decrease: 125 - 31.25 = 93.75. Net change = 6.25% decrease.

questions.question: Find the next term in the series: 5, 8, 13, 20, 29, ?
questions.explanation: The differences are 3, 5, 7, 9, ... (odd numbers increasing by 2). Next difference = 11. So next term = 29 + 11 = 40.

questions.question: The monthly sales (in Rs. thousands) of a shop are: Jan 45, Feb 50, Mar 55, Apr 60, May 48. What is the average monthly sales?
questions.explanation: Sum = 258. Average = 258 / 5 = 51.6 thousand.

questions.question: The length and breadth of a rectangular field are 60 m and 45 m respectively. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of rectangle = 60 x 45 = 2,700 sq m.

questions.question: Find the next term in the series: 2, 6, 18, 54, ?
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 3: 54x3=162.

questions.question: If 5x + 3 = 28, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: 5x + 3 = 28 means 5x = 25, so x = 5.

questions.question: In a survey of 300 people, 120 like tea, 100 like coffee, and 40 like both. How many people like neither tea nor coffee?
questions.explanation: People who like tea or coffee = 120 + 100 - 40 = 180. People who like neither = 300 - 180 = 120.

questions.question: A solid cylinder has a radius of 6 cm and a height of 14 cm. What is its curved surface area? (Take pi = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Curved surface area = 2 x pi x r x h = 2 x (22/7) x 6 x 14 = 528 sq cm.

questions.question: Statements: All cats are animals. All animals are living beings. Conclusion I: All cats are living beings. Conclusion II: All living beings are cats. Which conclusion follows?
questions.explanation: Since all cats are animals and all animals are living beings, conclusion I follows. However, 'all living beings are cats' does not follow.

questions.question: If 15 August 2025 falls on a Friday, what day of the week will 15 August 2026 fall on?
questions.explanation: 365 days pass (52 weeks + 1 day). The day advances by 1: Friday becomes Saturday.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 9:00?
questions.explanation: At 9:00, the hour hand points at 9 and the minute hand at 12. They are 3 hour-marks apart, each mark = 30 degrees. So angle = 90 degrees.

questions.question: In a row of 35 students, Ankit is 8th from the right end. What is his position from the left end?
questions.explanation: Position from left = Total - Position from right + 1 = 35 - 8 + 1 = 28th.

questions.question: Statements: All planets are spherical. Earth is a planet. Conclusion: Earth is spherical. Does the conclusion follow?
questions.explanation: All planets are spherical and Earth is a planet. Therefore, Earth must be spherical.

questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A is at the left end. B sits between A and C. D sits to the immediate right of C. Who sits at the right end?
questions.explanation: Arrangement from left: A B C D E. E sits at the right end.

questions.question: Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F have different heights. A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is taller than E but shorter than A. F is taller than D but shorter than B. Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: From the statements: C > A > B, A > D > E, and B > F > D. Combining: C > A > B > F > D > E. So C is the tallest.

questions.question: Which organ of the human body produces bile, which helps in the digestion of fats?
questions.explanation: Bile is produced by the liver and stored in the gall bladder.

questions.question: Baking soda, commonly used in cooking to make dough rise, is chemically known as?
questions.explanation: Baking soda is sodium hydrogen carbonate (NaHCO3), which releases carbon dioxide when heated or mixed with acids, causing dough to rise. Sodium chloride is common salt, calcium carbonate is chalk, and potassium hydroxide is caustic potash.

questions.question: Which vitamin is primarily synthesised in human skin in the presence of sunlight?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D is synthesised in the skin when exposed to UVB radiation from sunlight.

questions.question: The process by which green plants make their own food using sunlight is called:
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight, CO2, and water to produce glucose and oxygen.

questions.question: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately?
questions.explanation: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 3 × 10^8 m/s (about 299,792 km/s), which is one of the fundamental constants of physics.

questions.question: Which of the following is a biodegradable waste?
questions.explanation: Vegetable peel is organic waste that can be broken down naturally. Plastic, glass, and aluminium are non-biodegradable.

questions.question: A body of mass 10 kg is placed on the surface of the Earth. What is its weight? (Take g = 9.8 m/s^2)
questions.explanation: Weight = mass x acceleration due to gravity = 10 kg x 9.8 m/s^2 = 98 N.
